plan.why: Eric Sorenson is a Senior Product Manager at GitHub focused on supply chain security, working on open source at scale. Since Henry builds entertainment companies and intellectual property using AI and attends GitHub Universe 2026, meeting Eric can help Henry connect with a key person influencing open source security, relevant to Henry's interest in AI agents and creator tools. This meeting aligns with Henry's goal to meet builders in AI and dev storytelling.
angles: Introduce myself as founder of Unicorn Studios in San Francisco, building entertainment IP with AI, and mention my work with Animori and Metacomica in anime and comics IP.
Mention my recent personal experience working on the BLACKPINK shoot, highlighting creative and innovative projects I lead.
Express interest in supply chain security for open source projects and relate it to my demo goal of connecting with people working on AI agents and developer tools at GitHub Universe.
openers: Hi Eric, I’m Henry Finn, founder of Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I work on building AI-powered entertainment IP like anime and comics. I saw your session on stopping malicious packages, which sounds crucial in today’s open source environment.

Hey Eric, I just came from the AI Infra Summit and noticed you are a Senior Product Manager at GitHub focused on supply chain security. I’d love to hear how your work ties into creator tools and AI, I’m building in a similar space.
plan.followUp: Thank you for the conversation, Eric. It was great to learn about your work on GitHub Package Firewall and supply chain security. I will explore how my AI-driven entertainment IP projects can integrate or benefit from securing open source dependencies.
